## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-s4hana-api-sales-order-srv-setup-gui`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a communication user

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your SAP S/4HANA system. -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Communication Management → Maintain Communication Users. -->
3. Select **New** to create a new communication user.
4. <!-- manual: Fill in the following fields: -->
5. <!-- manual: User Name: Enter a name (e.g., BALLERINA_SLS_USR). -->
6. <!-- manual: Description: Enter a meaningful description. -->
7. <!-- manual: Password: Set a strong password and confirm it. -->
8. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Create a communication system

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to Communication Management → Communication Systems. -->
2. Select **New**.
3. <!-- manual: Fill in the following fields: -->
4. <!-- manual: System ID: Enter a unique ID (e.g., BALLERINA_INTEGRATION). -->
5. <!-- manual: System Name: Enter a display name. -->
6. <!-- manual: Host Name: Enter the hostname or IP of the system that will connect (your integration host). -->
7. <!-- manual: Under Users for Inbound Communication, add the communication user created in the previous step. -->
8. Select **Save**.

## Step 4: Create a communication arrangement for the sales order API

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to Communication Management → Communication Arrangements. -->
2. Select **New**.
3. <!-- manual: In the Communication Scenario field, search for and select SAP_COM_0109 (Sales Order Integration). -->
4. <!-- manual: In the Communication System field, select the communication system created in the previous step. -->
5. <!-- manual: Under Inbound Communication, confirm the authentication method is set to User ID and Password. -->
6. Select **Save**.

## Step 5: Retrieve the API hostname

1. <!-- manual: Open the saved Communication Arrangement. -->
2. <!-- manual: Under Inbound Services, locate the entry for Sales Order (A2X). -->
3. <!-- manual: Copy the Service URL. The hostname segment (e.g., my-system.s4hana.ondemand.com) is your hostname value. -->
4. Note the **User Name** of the inbound communication user; this is your `username`.
5. <!-- manual: Use the password set in step 1 as your password. -->
